config.section.backpack: Backpack Crafting · All Chests in Area
config.cookReadMode.name: Cooking menu reads chests
config.cookReadMode.desc: How the cooking menu finds ingredients: Off (default, vanilla: kitchen fridge only) / All chests (this location) / All chests + fridges (all locations) / All fridges (all locations, no other chests).
config.workbenchReadMode.name: Workbench chest reading
config.workbenchReadMode.desc: How the workbench reads chests: connected chests (default) / all chests in the area / all chests from all locations (cross-location) / off (only the 8 surrounding tiles, vanilla behavior).
config.backpackReadMode.name: Backpack crafting chest reading
config.backpackReadMode.desc: How the backpack crafting page reads chests: off (default, vanilla behaviour) / chests near the player (within 'Nearby range') / all chests in the area / all chests from all locations (cross-location).
mode.all: Read all chests in the area
mode.allLocations: Read all chests from all locations
config.includeMiniFridge.name: Include mini-fridges
config.includeMiniFridge.desc: Whether mini-fridges placed in the area are treated as available storage.
config.includeJunimo.name: Include Junimo chests
config.includeJunimo.desc: Whether Junimo chests are treated as available storage.
config.includeMiniShipping.name: Include mini shipping bins
config.includeMiniShipping.desc: Whether mini shipping bins are treated as available storage.
config.includeOtherStorage.name: Include other mod storage containers
config.includeOtherStorage.desc: Also count other mods' custom storage containers (NetMutex + IInventory) and storage furniture such as dressers.
config.backpackNearbyRange.name: Nearby range (side length)
config.backpackNearbyRange.desc: Side length of the square area centered on the player, chosen with the slider (3 = 3x3, 5 = 5x5 ... odd numbers, max 25 = 25x25). Default 13. Only used when the backpack page is set to 'chests near the player'.
config.cookoutFridge.name: Cookout Kit can use the fridge
config.cookoutFridge.desc: The Cookout Kit can't see any fridge indoors in vanilla. When on, it reads both the fridge and all mini-fridges in the current location.
